import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv", encoding="utf-8")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv", encoding="utf-8")


# Clean and prepare text data
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text)
    text = text.replace('\\"', '"')
    text = text.replace("\\n", "\n")
    text = text.strip('"')
    return text


# Apply cleaning function
train_df["Comment_clean"] = train_df.apply(lambda x: clean_text(x["Comment"]), axis=1)
test_df["Comment_clean"] = test_df.apply(lambda x: clean_text(x["Comment"]), axis=1)

# Handle empty Comment fields
train_df["Comment_clean"] = train_df["Comment_clean"].fillna("")
test_df["Comment_clean"] = test_df["Comment_clean"].fillna("")

# Vectorize text features
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    stop_words="english",
    min_df=1,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    dtype=np.float32,
)

X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["Comment_clean"])
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment_clean"])

# Create date feature matrix (frequency encoding per date)
date_counts = train_df["Date"].value_counts()
date_encoding_map = dict(date_counts.items())

X_date_train = []
for _, row in train_df.iterrows():
    count = date_encoding_map.get(row["Date"], 0)
    X_date_train.append([count])
X_date_train = np.array(X_date_train).reshape(-1, 1)

X_date_test = []
for _, row in test_df.iterrows():
    count = date_encoding_map.get(row["Date"], 0)
    X_date_test.append([count])
X_date_test = np.array(X_date_test).reshape(-1, 1)

# Combine features
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_vec.toarray(), X_date_train], format="csr")
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_vec.toarray(), X_date_test], format="csr")

# Prepare labels
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values.astype(float)

# IMPORTANT: Split BEFORE training to get genuine hold-out estimate
X_val, X_tr, y_val, y_tr = train_test_split(
    X_train_combined, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train classifier
model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=15,
    min_samples_leaf=10,
    class_weight="balanced",
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Validate on holdout set (genuine estimate - was never used for training)
val_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
auc_roc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred_proba)
print(f"{auc_roc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set (unlabeled data)
test_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]

# Ensure probabilities are valid
test_pred_proba = np.clip(test_pred_proba, 0.0, 1.0)

# Create submission file in correct location
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Prediction": test_pred_proba.tolist()})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Final verification
print(f"Final AUC-ROC: {auc_roc:.6f}")
print(f"Submission saved: {submission.to_csv('./submission/submission.csv')}")
